ThingDef.label: animus totem of friendship
ThingDef.description: A totem of carved jade stones. When connected to an anima tree and fueled with anima grass, taps into the anima network to emit a worldwide psychic signal. This signal subtly influences other factions to view your colony more favorably.\n\nFor non-permanently hostile factions, increases goodwill by 2 per day, up to a cap of 100 over their natural goodwill.
